name: How much should a bathroom remodel cost in Los Angeles for a standard 5x8 bath?

mainEntity.name: What is a realistic price range for a standard 5x8 bathroom remodel in Los Angeles, and what changes the price the most?
mainEntity.text: What is a realistic price range for a standard 5x8 bathroom remodel in Los Angeles, and what changes the price the most?

acceptedAnswer.text: A realistic budget for a standard 5x8 bathroom in Los Angeles usually depends on scope more than room size. A simple refresh with new vanity, tile, fixtures, and paint can be much less expensive than a full gut remodel that moves plumbing, changes the layout, or upgrades electrical and ventilation. The biggest cost drivers are labor, tile selection, shower type, fixture quality, waterproofing, and whether the project requires permits or sub-scope engineering. Homeowners should also budget for demolition surprises such as damaged subfloors, old plumbing, or hidden moisture issues. For the most accurate estimate, compare the same scope apples-to-apples across contractors and ask whether the price includes waterproofing, permits, haul-away, and finish installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard 5x8 bathroom remodel in Los Angeles often falls into a wide range because labor, materials, plumbing changes, and finish level all drive the total. Cosmetic updates cost far less than full gut renovations. Layout changes, custom tile, waterproofing upgrades, and permit work usually increase the price the fastest.
